say:3:1029504001:1.text: Pah! I looked all over, but there's nothing special here.
say:3:1029504001:1.source_cn: 呼……看了一大圈，这里也没什么特殊的啊。

say:4:1029504002:1.text: I thought it would be something like a cave with buried gems that we could find just by digging.
say:4:1029504002:1.source_cn: 我还以为会是类似埋藏宝石的洞穴那样，挖开土就能找到了。

say:5:1029504003:1.text: A secret that could be solved just like that wouldn't have become a legend about Celestials.
say:5:1029504003:1.source_cn: 如果是随意就能被解开的秘密，也不会成为与神有关的传说。

say:6:1029504004:1.text: It takes courage, wisdom, and piety to discern the traces of a Celestial.
say:6:1029504004:1.source_cn: 神的行迹，需要用勇气，智慧，虔诚才可窥得一二。

say:7:1029504005:1.text: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:7:1029504005:1.source_cn: 不过在这附近，确实没有找到可用的线索。<style=s...
say:7:1029504005:1.male: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:7:1029504005:1.female: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:8:1029504005.text: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.source_cn: 不过在这附近，确实没有找到可用的线索。<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，怎么说？
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.male: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:8:1029504005.female: But there really aren't any clues around here. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:9:1029504006:1.text: Alya's the best of the bunch. If she only got part of it...
say:9:1029504006:1.source_cn: 阿莉雅已经是最厉害的学者了，如果她只考证到一部分……

say:10:1029504007:1.text: Other scholars are unlikely to have any further info.
say:10:1029504007:1.source_cn: 其他的学者也不可能再掌握更多信息了。

say:11:1029504008:1.text: Maybe people in the nearby villages know something about Nakalig's treasure. Let's go ask around.
say:11:1029504008:1.source_cn: 关于月神的宝藏，附近村落中的人或许会知道什么。找他们打...

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 找附近的学者们打探一下？

say:13:1029504009:2.text: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—
say:13:1029504009:2.male: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—
say:13:1029504009:2.female: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> said so, we might as well take a nap—

say:16:1029504011:1.text: Fine, then, humorless knight. Let's go ask the locals.
say:16:1029504011:1.source_cn: 好吧，没有幽默感的圣骑士。那我们向附近的居民打听看看吧。

choice:8:1:2.text: Maybe we should sleep on it.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 也许睡一觉会有新线索
choice:8:1:2.male: Maybe we should sleep on it.
choice:8:1:2.female: Maybe we should sleep on it.

say:17:1029504012:1.text: Yes, they might be able to offer some clues.
say:17:1029504012:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们可能会有一些辅助的线索。

say:18:1029504013:1.source_cn: 那我们就在附近找找看！
